title: Skip an item with next
objective: Use next to skip the rest of one loop run and move on to the next item.

body.text: next skips the rest of the lines in the current run of the loop and moves on to the next item. Unlike stop, the loop keeps going. Use it when only some items should be handled, such as skipping empty entries or negative numbers.

body.title: Skip the negative numbers
body.code:
make numbers equal to a list of -1, 2, 3
repeat for each value in numbers
    if value is less than 0
        next
    say value

body.text: next works the same way with repeat times. Here the number 5 is skipped, and the loop continues after it.

body.title: Skip one turn
body.code:
repeat 10 times using i
    if i is equal to 5
        next
    say i

body.prompt: The program totals every score, including the negative one, so it prints 25. Only the positive scores should count. Make it print 30.
body.starter:
make scores equal to a list of 10, -5, 20
make changing total equal to 0
repeat for each score in scores
    increase total by score
say total
body.solution:
make scores equal to a list of 10, -5, 20
make changing total equal to 0
repeat for each score in scores
    if score is at most 0
        next
    increase total by score
say total

checks.description: It uses next inside the loop
